The aggregator processed 16,863 articles across 11 runs this week, averaging 80 quality articles per run. News dominated the category breakdown with 275 articles, followed by AI-tech with 166 and wellness with 110. Twenty feeds were added this week, including Columbia Journalism Review, Nieman Lab, and Hyperallergic for editorial and design content, alongside technical blogs from Dropbox, Pinterest, and MIT's STS program.
